reference.source: Parsons' Diseases of the Eye 23rd Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Snow in vitreous means intermediate disease
Scar plus fresh edge means toxoplasmosis
Behcet needs ulcers in two places plus eyes
Endophthalmitis pain with no view: inject
reference.pathophysiology: Blood retinal barrier breakdown lets leukocytes and protein flood vitreous (haze and snowballs) while choroidal granulomas choke choriocapillaris into focal necrosis; Toxoplasma cysts rupture periodically reactivating edge retinitis beside old scars.
additionalDifferentials: Intermediate versus posterior by vitreous versus retinal focus
Toxoplasmosis versus CMV by immunity and scar pattern
Endophthalmitis versus sterile uveitis by pain and vitritis
additionalInvestigations: Fluorescein angiography for vasculitis and ischaemia
Vitreous tap with PCR and cultures in suspected infection
